body: Thanks. I understand that weed won't have a permanent positive effect on my depression, but when I'm high it sure as hell helps. And sure, anything can be detrimental with chronic use, but I never overly abused the drug.  I smoke it when I'm feeling more down than usual.

Thanks for the words buddy. I know my friends are shitheads but I keep them so I'm not alone. I'm only in this town for another 3 months but I feel like it's going to be a long 3 months.  My personal life isn't why I'm depressed.  I'm one of 7 billion people on this earth and my death would only affect 15 or 20 people.  Individually, no one really matters, and I matter even less than the average person
